**Replace string concatenation with a template literal in the Okta ACS URL test.** `yarn lint` runs ESLint over `frontend/`, and the `airbnb` preset enables `prefer-template` as an error. The added test line `okta_acs_url: " " + data.okta_acs_url + " ",` uses concatenation, so the `lint-js` job fails on it. The same pattern appears in `IntegrationForm.tests.tsx`, which fails the same way.
Suggested fix
```diff - okta_acs_url: " " + data.okta_acs_url + " ", + okta_acs_url: ` ${data.okta_acs_url} `, ``` Apply the same change to `frontend/pages/admin/IntegrationsPage/cards/Integrations/components/IntegrationForm/IntegrationForm.tests.tsx:13`: ```diff - { ...data, url: " " + data.url + " ", email: " " + data.email + " " }, + { ...data, url: ` ${data.url} `, email: ` ${data.email} ` }, ```
